usage:

evidence.reason: After edit, ignores units, calls metering.reset() and metering.evaluate(0, 0.1, "benchmark"), and returns metering.historySize() instead of a charge, breaking the test assertion subscriptionCharge(40) > 0.
Right edit adds early return 0 for units === 0; combined with left edit passing 0 to evaluate, the charge path is bypassed and the positive-charge invariant fails.
Test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0, both of which are violated by the merged subscriptionCharge behavior.
Dependency path subscriptionCharge -> evaluate -> usageCharge is broken because subscriptionCharge no longer forwards units to evaluate.

result.userExplanation: 合并后 subscriptionCharge 不再把 units 传给 evaluate，而是固定评估 0 并返回 historySize()，导致订阅计费恒为 0，违反测试中 subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 的预期。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/subscription.ts 中的 subscriptionCharge，恢复将 units 参数传递给 metering.evaluate(units, 0.1, "monthly") 并返回计费结果，而不是调用 metering.reset() 和 metering.historySize()。
